target: Add tldr field to all 53 genuinely_prospective prediction entries missing it in data/predictions.json

patches.description: Add tldr field to 53 prediction entries that have detail_reasoning but no tldr. Each tldr is 2-3 sentences, plain language, punchline first. Apply via: d.entries.forEach(e => { if(tldrs[e.id] && !e.tldr) e.tldr = tldrs[e.id]; })

tldr_data.W018: hmF2 descent during high solar wind pressure is textbook ionospheric physics, fully derived by standard space weather models. Both models predict the same direction; the dome provides no magnitude derivation from its own geometry. The sign-match is non-discriminating.
tldr_data.W020: The dome author self-classified this as REFINED, conceding the predicted 3% geopotential anomaly is smaller than observed — effectively a self-acknowledged failure. Roaring 40s circulation is fully explained by Ferrel-cell dynamics and Coriolis forcing. Quantitative prediction fails by the dome's own evaluation.
tldr_data.W021: The Moon's elliptical orbit (eccentricity ~0.0549) produces ~12% angular size variation — trivially exceeding the >2% threshold on any model that acknowledges lunar orbital mechanics. The bar is set so low it cannot distinguish dome from globe geometry. Non-discriminating.
tldr_data.W022: This tracking entry restates WIN-040 (SAA western cell west of 45°W) using the same data and the same claim. No new predictive content is added beyond the existing WIN. Counted here for tracking completeness.
tldr_data.W027-PRED-R006: The dome predicted Schumann resonance elevation during G3+ storms; the author self-classified this as FALSIFIED after observing the opposite (suppression). D-region conductivity increase during storms lowers cavity Q-factor, correctly predicting suppression under standard ionospheric physics.
tldr_data.W028: Crepuscular rays appear to diverge from the sun due to perspective projection of parallel light beams through atmospheric scattering — standard optics. Crucially, anticrepuscular rays simultaneously converge at the antisolar point 180° opposite, which is geometrically impossible with a local light source at 5,733 km. The anticrepuscular pattern refutes the local-sun interpretation even as the crepuscular pattern superficially supports it.
tldr_data.W029: Equinox day lengths are computed to sub-second accuracy from axial tilt, atmospheric refraction, and solar disc diameter — standard astronomical formulae. The dome provides no quantitative prediction of what its own geometry would produce differently. The claimed match cannot distinguish standard astronomy from dome geometry.
tldr_data.PRED-099: Restates WIN-065. Polaris sits 0.74° from the true celestial pole (declination ~89.26° as of 2026), and the apparent elevation excess at any latitude follows from this polar offset plus atmospheric refraction. No new predictive content beyond WIN-065.
tldr_data.PRED-100: Restates WIN-056. The formula H(φ) = 90° − |φ + θ| covertly uses the globe's declination formula (derived from 23.45° axial tilt), making it circular with respect to the dome model's geometry. No new predictive content.
tldr_data.PRED-PARALLAX-001: Hipparcos measured ~118,000 stellar parallaxes to milliarcsecond precision; Gaia DR3 extended this to 1.8 billion stars at microarcsecond precision. Observed parallaxes range from ~0.77 arcseconds down — the predicted >3° scatter would be off by a factor of ~14,000 on the nearest star alone. Among the most catastrophically falsified claims in the catalog.
tldr_data.PRED-MOON-001: Atmospheric refraction lifts all celestial bodies near the horizon by ~34 arcminutes (standard almanac value), causing the Moon to appear above its geometric position at setting. This has been tabulated since Tycho Brahe (1590s) and is fully explained by standard atmospheric optics. No dome derivation of the latitude dependence is provided.
tldr_data.PRED-NEW-002: The claimed 9.2 km/s aetheric gravity wave speed is indistinguishable from known seismic P-wave velocities (8–13 km/s in the upper mantle) without an independent measurement protocol. No instrument distinguishes aetheric waves from seismic waves. The value appears reverse-engineered from published seismological data.
tldr_data.PRED-NEW-003: No protocol exists to measure the density of a medium that interacts with nothing except dome-specific phenomena. The value (3.4×10¹⁷ kg/m³, comparable to neutron star densities) appears derived by fitting dome parameters to desired wave speeds — circular by construction. A free parameter is not a testable prediction.
tldr_data.PRED-GRAV-001: Tsumeb, Namibia lies near the Congo craton with known mining-induced subsurface voids — a well-documented positive gravity anomaly in all published GRACE datasets predating registration. Predicting an anomaly at a location where one already exists in public data is post-hoc adoption, not prospective prediction.
tldr_data.PRED-087: The Indian Ocean Geoid Low reflects deep-mantle density anomalies (likely Tethyan slab remnants) that evolve over millions of years; stationarity on human timescales is the default geodetic expectation. The feature has been continuously mapped by GRACE, GOCE, and EGM2008/EGM2020 since the 1970s. Predicting that a published stable feature stays stable is non-discriminating.
tldr_data.PRED-088: 70°N, 135°W falls within the Hudson Bay gravity low — the largest negative free-air anomaly in North America, caused by post-glacial rebound from the Laurentide Ice Sheet and published in GRACE/GOCE global models. The feature predates registration and is fully explained by isostatic rebound theory. Post-hoc adoption.
tldr_data.PRED-111: 30°S, 60°E is near the Southwest Indian Ridge with well-documented crustal gravity anomalies in public GRACE/GOCE data. Any >20 mGal feature at these coordinates was already mapped and published before registration. Post-hoc adoption of a pre-existing published observation.
tldr_data.PRED-112: Large-scale gravity anomalies reflect crustal thickness and mantle density variations that evolve over millennia — positional stability through 2028 is the trivially correct prediction by standard geophysics. The dome adds no novel prediction about mechanisms or rates of change. Non-discriminating.
tldr_data.PRED-084: The P-wave shadow zone at 104–140° has been known since Oldham (1906) and Gutenberg (1914), quantitatively explained by refraction through the liquid outer core in PREM and ak135 models. Registration in 2026 postdates over a century of published seismology. No dome derivation of the 104–140° boundaries is offered.
tldr_data.PRED-085: S-waves cannot propagate through the liquid outer core, creating the S-wave shadow beyond ~104° — textbook since Oldham 1906. The dome's 120–160° range overlaps but doesn't match the standard prediction precisely, and no dome derivation explains the specific boundaries. Post-hoc adoption without a dome-derived mechanism.
tldr_data.PRED-077: M2 tidal amplitude is driven by the Moon's orbital parameters (which change only on millennial timescales), making sub-0.5% annual variation a trivially correct prediction from standard tidal theory. UHSLC harmonic analysis data for Honolulu is publicly available and predates registration. Non-discriminating and post-hoc.
tldr_data.PRED-090: Restates WIN-066 (Northern hemisphere TOA flux excess). WIN-066 is verdicted Std Model Explains: the hemispheric energy imbalance follows from NH land-mass fraction, differential cloud cover, and aerosol forcing (Loeb et al. 2016). No new predictive content.
tldr_data.PRED-091: The NH heat excess is a direct consequence of NH land-mass fraction (~39% vs SH ~19%) and AMOC heat transport, quantified by Loeb et al. 2021 within standard climate physics. The +0.36 W/m² figure is within the published range and derives from existing observations without dome geometry. No independent dome derivation provided.
tldr_data.PRED-081: No cosmological model predicts detectable cosmic acceleration at z<0.1 — the Hubble flow is essentially linear at these distances. The 1998 Nobel-winning discovery used high-redshift supernovae (z~0.3–0.9) precisely because local supernovae cannot separate acceleration from peculiar velocities. The predicted result is consistent with all models and discriminates nothing.
tldr_data.PRED-082: Restates WIN-054 (El Gordo cluster velocity). The 2012 velocity estimate the dome cites has been superseded by Donnert (2014) and Zhang et al. (2015) hydrodynamic simulations showing velocities of ~2,000–2,500 km/s are consistent with ΛCDM. No new predictive content.
tldr_data.PRED-097: Restates WIN-055 (CMB quadrupole/octupole alignment). The alignment was discovered in 2004 and confirmed by Planck (2018). Predicting that LiteBIRD will confirm an already-confirmed result is retrospective, not prospective. No new predictive content.
tldr_data.PRED-SLIP-001: Restates WIN-058, reframing the North Atlantic jet stream as an aetheric current. WIN-058 is verdicted Misleading: the identity θ = −lon_E follows from the definition of geographic longitude. No new predictive content.
tldr_data.PRED-SLIP-002: North Pacific jet stream eastbound advantage follows from Coriolis-driven westerlies on a rotating globe, documented since the 1950s. The dome relabels this as aetheric current effect but adds no predictive content about magnitude, altitude, or seasonal variation. Post-hoc relabeling.
tldr_data.PRED-SLIP-003: Southern Ocean westerly wind belt (Roaring 40s/Furious 50s) produces strong directional asymmetry measured by satellite scatterometry since the 1990s and derived from first principles by general circulation models. The dome relabels observed circulation as aetheric current. Post-hoc adoption.
tldr_data.PRED-SLIP-004: No measurable metric, threshold, or observable signature is specified for an Atlantic/Pacific aetheric current boundary at 40°W–20°W. Ocean current boundaries in this longitude range are explained by thermohaline circulation. Without a testable prediction, this cannot be confirmed or falsified.
tldr_data.PRED-CURR-001: The North Atlantic polar jet (100–200 kt at FL350) consistently favors eastbound routing, documented since the 1930s–40s jet stream discovery and used operationally by every major carrier. Coriolis-driven westerlies predict the same direction on a globe. Non-discriminating.
tldr_data.PRED-CURR-002: North Pacific jet stream eastbound advantage follows identical Coriolis physics to PRED-CURR-001, with 1–2 hour differences tracked by airlines since the 1950s. The dome relabels the jet stream as aetheric current but predicts nothing additional about magnitude, altitude, or seasonal variation.
tldr_data.PRED-CURR-003: The Deep Western Boundary Current and Labrador Current produce southward flow in the western Atlantic below the thermocline — integral components of the Atlantic Meridional Overturning Circulation (Stommel 1948). This is pure relabeling of a well-characterized textbook ocean circulation feature.
tldr_data.PRED-CURR-004: The South Atlantic Anomaly is a magnetic field feature (reduced intensity), not an atmospheric convergence zone. No station, amplitude, frequency, or test window is specified for 'southern hemisphere inflow toward the SAA.' Without these, the prediction cannot be tested.
tldr_data.PRED-CURR-005-REV: An aetheric current through continental landmass has no mechanism, no detectable signature, no penetration depth, and no attenuation rate. If the claim is taken literally (currents unimpeded by rock), it predicts nothing distinguishable from a universe where no such currents exist. Structurally unfalsifiable.
tldr_data.PRED-CURR-006: The Gulf Stream has been documented since Franklin's 1769 chart and is explained by Sverdrup balance and western intensification (Stommel 1948). Relabeling it as an aetheric current makes no new prediction about its path, speed, depth, or seasonal behavior. Pure post-hoc relabeling.
tldr_data.PRED-CURR-008: A single global eastward atmospheric rotation is directly contradicted by the observed trade winds (westward in the tropics), polar easterlies, and the stratospheric quasi-biennial oscillation. The multi-cell Hadley/Ferrel/polar structure is one of the most robustly observed features of atmospheric science.
tldr_data.PRED-CURR-AUS-001: Sydney–Perth eastbound advantage follows from Southern Hemisphere mid-latitude jet stream (Coriolis-driven westerlies), with airlines publishing asymmetric block times for decades. The dome adds no predictive content about magnitude, altitude, or seasonal variation.
tldr_data.PRED-EGG-001: No pre-registered metric, dataset, or success criterion specifies how an egg-shaped disc would outperform a circle. With free parameters (eccentricity, orientation, scaling), any shape can be post-hoc fitted to distance data. Without pre-commitment to a specific metric and independent test dataset, this is curve-fitting, not a testable prediction.
tldr_data.PRED-COORD-001: Restates WIN-058 (unified angular coordinate θ = −lon_E). The identity θ = −lon_E is a trivial consequence of how geographic longitude is defined — sundials measure local solar time, which maps to longitude by definition. No new predictive content.
tldr_data.PRED-V13-001: No metric tensor components, measurable observable (flight time, geodesic distance, signal delay), or falsification criterion are specified. Finsler geometry is a real mathematical framework, but without an explicit metric function F(x, dx) and a derived prediction, the claim is empty jargon. Unfalsifiable by omission.
tldr_data.PRED-V13-002: The SAA is quantitatively explained by the ~450 km eccentric dipole offset (IGRF-13). The dome reinterprets it as an ovoid shoulder compression region but provides no field strength, spatial extent, or temporal drift rate distinguishing dome physics from standard geomagnetic modeling. Unfalsifiable for want of a prediction.
tldr_data.PRED-V13-003: n(r) is the dome model's primary escape hatch: any observational discrepancy at the Antarctic rim can be absorbed by adjusting the refractive index. The parameter IS the explanation for why observations appear globe-consistent, so no measurement can independently test it. Unfalsifiable by design.
tldr_data.PRED-V13-004: Great-circle routes ARE the geodesics on WGS84 because Earth is a sphere — the dome disc coordinate system was itself fitted to globe distances (disc_radius = 20,015 km ≈ globe semi-circumference). The claimed correlation is a consequence of the dome's coordinate fitting, not confirmation of dome physics.
tldr_data.PRED-V13-005: The dome author self-classified this as FALSIFIED. Satellite imagery from multiple independent agencies, continuous Antarctic research station occupancy since 1956, and circumnavigation routes all confirm no habitable land exists beyond the Antarctic ice ring. One of the rare self-acknowledged failures in the catalog.
tldr_data.PRED-TESLA-001: Restates WIN-062. Tesla's 1.57c is a real superluminal phase velocity in the Earth-ionosphere waveguide on a sphere (Wait 1966; Cummer 2000); Tesla's own patent (US 787412) shows a spherical Earth diagram. The dome relabels globe circumference as disc diameter, producing numerical agreement by construction. No new predictive content.
tldr_data.PRED-TESLA-004: 'Ovoid splitting' is undefined jargon — not a recognized term in spectral analysis, acoustics, or electromagnetic theory. Without specifying which frequencies constitute the harmonic series, what quantity exhibits splitting, the predicted split frequency, and what would falsify the claim, this prediction has no operational content.
tldr_data.PRED-TOROID-002: 8,619 km is the dome's own exponential decay constant from H(r) = 8,537·exp(−r/8,619) — a model parameter, not an independently measurable wavelength. No geophysical observable corresponds to a 'two-pole toroidal wavelength' at 8,619 km scale. The decay constant cannot simultaneously be a model premise and a confirmed prediction of that model.
tldr_data.PRED-TOROID-004: Antarctic magnetometer anomalies are well-documented consequences of proximity to the geomagnetic south pole, auroral oval current systems, and South Atlantic Anomaly dynamics — all measured by INTERMAGNET stations (Scott Base, Mawson, Vostok) predating registration. The dome attributes standard geomagnetic observations to a separately undetectable toroidal field.
tldr_data.PRED-TOROID-005: Sub-terrestrial currents flow through a region physically inaccessible by definition — no instrument can detect currents through a hypothetical sub-disc structure. The 40–60° band coincides with mid-latitude weather systems on a globe, so any signal would be indistinguishable from standard atmospheric/oceanic patterns. Doubly unfalsifiable.
tldr_data.PRED-TOROID-007: Claiming that south polar field excess 'scales with λ_g = 8,619 km' is circular — 8,619 km is the dome's own exponential decay constant, not an independently derived quantity. WIN-053 already addresses this scaling claim. A model parameter cannot simultaneously be a premise and a confirmed prediction.
tldr_data.PRED-DOME-001: The dome's own refraction function n(r) reaches 28.8 at the ice wall, making direct observation of the dome boundary physically impossible within the model. Any claimed range (46,000–78,000 km) is unmeasurable and unfalsifiable by the model's own terms. Unfalsifiable by construction — the model forbids the very test that would confirm it.
tldr_data.PRED-BEYOND-001: The aetheric pressure barrier is the dome model's foundational escape hatch: it explains why no observation can penetrate the model's edge. A claim whose function is to make the model immune to observation cannot itself be tested by observation. This is the model's unfalsifiability mechanism, not a testable prediction.

tldr_evidence: 53 prediction entries verified missing tldr field via node check against data/predictions.json. All entries have detail_reasoning of 300-700 chars used as source material. TLDRs are 2-3 sentences each, punchline-first, plain language. Verdicts respected: falsified entries note the failure, recycled entries note which WIN they restate, unfalsifiable entries explain why, standard_physics entries explain the standard explanation.
tldr_verdict: Routine progressive-disclosure improvement. No verdict changes. All 53 entries get 2-3 sentence TLDRs. Decider should apply as a scripted JSON merge.
